# EZ Texting
> EZ Texting is an SMS and MMS marketing platform for businesses and organizations, founded in 2004. It supports bulk SMS/MMS campaigns, two-way conversational texting, automation and multi-step workflows, RCS, dedicated short codes, and a developer SMS API — with built-in A2P/10DLC compliance and CRM integrations.
Last updated: 2026-06-23
EZ Texting helps small businesses and enterprises reach customers by text: grow opt-in contact lists, send mass or triggered messages, automate replies, and measure results. Self-serve plans start at $25/month with a 14-day free trial (no credit card required); see Pricing below.
## Get Started
- [Pricing](https://www.eztexting.com/pricing): EZ Texting plans — Launch, Boost, Scale, and Enterprise — with monthly/annual prices, included message credits, per-credit overage rates, add-ons, and the 14-day free trial.
- [Start a Free Trial](https://www.eztexting.com/start): Create an account and start texting on a 14-day free trial — no credit card required.
- [Request a Demo](https://www.eztexting.com/demo): Book a guided walkthrough of EZ Texting with the team.
- [Integrations](https://www.eztexting.com/integrations): Connect EZ Texting to tools like HubSpot, Mailchimp, Constant Contact, Squarespace, Stripe, and Zapier.
## Product Overview
- [Product](https://www.eztexting.com/features): EZ Texting’s SMS features include powerful contact management and messaging tools like automated messaging, analytics, and integration with CRM systems.
- [How Does Text Marketing Work?](https://www.eztexting.com/how-text-marketing-works): How does EZ Texting SMS marketing work? Learn how to get started & most importantly, how to do it effectively here.
## SMS Marketing Features
- [RCS](https://www.eztexting.com/features/rcs): Discover Rich Communication Services (RCS) texting; interactive messaging with dynamic multimedia, verified business branding, read receipts, and more for iPhone and Android devices.
- [Mass Texting](https://www.eztexting.com/resources/sms-resources/mass-text-messaging): Learn how to send mass text messages with the best mass texting service available, EZ Texting. Explore mass text laws and software features like personalization.
- [Conversational Texting](https://www.eztexting.com/features/two-way-texting): Discover the benefits of two-way SMS Messaging for real-time customer engagement, automated responses, and efficient marketing.
- [Text Automations](https://www.eztexting.com/features/text-message-automation): Discover the best automated texting software for businesses. Improve engagement, streamline marketing, and boost efficiency with SMS automation tools.
- [Workflows](https://www.eztexting.com/features/workflows): Learn which flows you should send for SMS to improve engagement, streamline communication, and boost efficiency.
- [Text-to-Pay](https://www.eztexting.com/features/text-to-pay): Get paid faster with EZ Texting’s text-to-pay. Create and send secure payment request links and collect payments by text.
- [Text-to-Give](https://www.eztexting.com/features/text-to-give): Empower donors to give instantly with text-to-give. Securely request and collect donations by text right from the EZ Texting platform.
- [Short Codes](https://www.eztexting.com/features/dedicated-short-codes): Discover the benefit of a dedicated short code for your business & your text message marketing.
- [AI Compose](https://www.eztexting.com/features/ai-compose): Streamline your sms marketing processes with AI Compose, the easiest AI SMS generator service to use.
- [AI Reply](https://www.eztexting.com/features/ai-reply): Generate accurate, on-brand text replies in seconds. AI Reply streamlines inbox management while keeping you in full control.
- [SMS API](https://www.eztexting.com/features/sms-api): Integrate a custom SMS API, automate messaging, and optimize your campaigns to drive authentic engagement at scale.
## Engagement and Reporting
- [Leads](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/leads): SMS lead generation with EZ Texting provides the most efficient way to instantly connect to potential customers and showcase your sales and marketing messages.
- [Appointments](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/appointments): Maximize your scheduling efficiency with EZ Texting. Appointment reminders can boost your engagement and conversion rates.
- [Employee Engagement](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/employee-engagement): Boost employee engagement with EZ Texting. Use SMS to enhance communication, increase team participation, and improve overall workplace satisfaction.
- [Alerts](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/alerts): Text alerts provide the fastest and most effective way to reach a large audience instantly. When every second counts, send an SMS text alert.
- [Donations](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/donations): Instantly connect to your audience, drive more donations, and beat your fundraising goals with the best-in-class text-to-give SMS platform, EZ Texting.
- [Attendees](https://www.eztexting.com/turn-texts-into/attendees): A powerful SMS marketing service like EZ Texting can drive event attendance and power your IRL success with features and tools designed for text invitations and reminders.
## Targeted Solutions
- [Solutions](https://www.eztexting.com/solutions): EZ Texting provides businesses with unparalleled text marketing solutions like bulk SMS campaigns, rapid customer communication, employee operations & more.
- [Nonprofits](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/nonprofits): Boost your nonprofit’s impact with SMS for nonprofits from EZ Texting. Send urgent updates, rally support, and drive results fast.
- [Churches](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/church): EZ Texting is the leading text messaging service for churches, helping ministries connect, grow, and engage their communities easily.
- [eCommerce](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/ecommerce): Discover SMS marketing for eCommerce that drives sales, boosts customer loyalty, and recovers abandoned carts with personalized, automated text campaigns.
- [Retailers](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/retail): Discover sms marketing for retail that boosts sales, engages shoppers, and recovers carts with automated, personalized text campaigns.
- [Political Campaigns](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/political-texting): Explore the power of political texting. Learn effective strategies, discover essential tools, and elevate your outreach game with SMS marketing.
- [Healthcare Providers](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/healthcare): SMS for healthcare that cuts no-shows, boosts patient engagement, and keeps staff informed with secure, automated text reminders.
- [K-12 Schools](https://www.eztexting.com/industries/schools): Engage parents, students, and staff with EZ Texting’s SMS for schools—alerts, reminders, and campaigns to keep your K-12 community connected.
- [All Industries](https://www.eztexting.com/industries): EZ Texting has customized solutions to fit your business. Find your industry here and learn more about how EZ Texting can jump start your text marketing!

Built-In Trust for SMS Marketing Campaigns

Your Audience

With Ease

 SMS Marketing Features
 A powerful suite of SMS marketing features make it faster and easier to communicate with your contacts.
 
 
 Securing Your Textable Numbers
 Choosing the right number is an important step in the SMS journey, 
and with EZ Texting, you’ve got options.
 
10-Digit Long Code
Secure a trusted 10DLC number
 
Toll-Free Number
Promote trust with an 800 number
 
Dedicated Short Code
Boost engagement with a memorable short code 858585
 
Text-to-Landline
Turn your landline into a textable number
 Managing Your Contacts
 Save time and get closer to your contacts by importing, customizing, and 
segmenting your contacts for easy targeting and personalization.
 
Unlimited Contacts
 Add limitless contacts without restriction

Key Factors That Influence SMS Marketing Pricing
Frequency of Messaging
The number of text messages you plan to send directly affects the cost of text marketing. At EZ Texting, each plan comes with 500 credits, plus the option to purchase more.
Quantity of Contacts
Each outbound message uses credits per recipient, so larger audiences consume credits faster. EZ Texting plans scale with your list and include unlimited contact uploads, making it easy to grow.
Message Type: SMS vs MMS
SMS messages (text only, 160 characters) are 1 credit each, and MMS messages (including images or video, and/or up to 1600 characters) are 3 credits each.

Frequently Asked Questions
Pricing & Credits
 
What are the typical SMS marketing pricing ranges?
 
 
SMS marketing pricing can range from $0.01 - $0.05 per SMS based on your plan. Monthly subscription plans usually cost between $25 - $500+ per month.
If you have high-volume messaging needs, plans can price at $500 - $5,000 monthly. EZ Texting is proud to offer industry-leading SMS marketing solutions at a fraction of the cost of the competition.
 
 
 
What is a credit?
 
 
Credits are the form of currency used to measure each message you send to each contact. Typically, it costs 1 credit to send 1 SMS message, and 3 credits to send 1 MMS.
1 credit = $0.03 (price can vary between plans)
1 SMS message (160 characters or less) = 1 credit
1 MMS message (up to 1600 characters, may include a photo, GIF, or video) = up to 3 credits
 
 
Do EZ Texting credits rollover?
 
 
For customers on our current standard monthly plans, unused credits roll over for one additional billing cycle as long as your subscription remains active. In practice, that means credits stay usable for up to two months from the date they were issued.
Rollover isn’t guaranteed on legacy plans or custom/Direct Sales (DSC) plans and might vary by contract.
For annual plans, credits are issued upfront and expire 12 months after purchase.
Learn more about
 how EZ Texting credits work
.
 
 
Can I purchase more credits?
 
 
Once you have purchased a plan with EZ Texting, you can add more credits at any time. And to maximize the value of all your credits, EZ Texting offers rollover credits. Credits rollover for one month only and rollover is only available to those on a monthly plan.
 
 
Will I be charged for inbound messages?
 
 
No, you will not be charged for inbound messages with EZ Texting, unlike many of our competitors.
 
 
How much does an SMS cost?
 
 
An SMS message (text only, up to 160 characters) will cost 1 credit.
 
 
How much does an MMS cost?
 
 
An MMS message (up to 1600 characters and/or includes an image/gif/video) will cost 3 credits.
 
 
How do I estimate how many credits I need?
 
 
The best way to estimate how many credits you will need is to look at your current subscriber list and how often you would like to send messages. Multiply the number of subscribers you currently have by the number of messages you would like to send to get an idea of how many credits you may need. Keep in mind that SMS messages (text only, 160 characters) are 1 credit each, and MMS messages (including images or video, and/or up to 1600 characters) are 3 credits each.
 
 
What carrier fees do you charge?
 
 
The $5/month Telecom Fee covers mandatory carrier fees for Launch plan customers, ensuring compliance and reliable message delivery. This fee is waived for Boost, Scale, and Enterprise plans.
Additionally, customers messaging from 10-digit numbers have all other carrier fees included in their pricing plan.
 
 
Can I change my plan?
 
 
Within your EZ Texting, you can easily pause, cancel or upgrade your plan at anytime.
 
Features & Plans
 
What is the difference between SMS and MMS?
 
 
SMS messages are text only messages that can have up to 160 characters.
MMS messages can contain text up to 1600 characters long, and can include an image, video or gif.
 
 
Are SMS and MMS the same price?
 
 
No. SMS messages are 1 credit and are capped at 160 alphanumeric characters. MMS messages feature longer message lengths (up to 1600 alphanumeric characters) as well as added images, GIFs, or video, which is why they are typically 3 credits.
 
 
Is A2P carrier registration included in my EZ Texting plan?
 
 
Yes! EZ Texting plans include carrier registration at no extra cost. Other providers often charge this as a hidden fee at checkout, but we make it easy and transparent by including it in your plan. 
Completing A2P carrier registration
 is required to send messages; we handle it for you!
 
 
What is the difference between inbound and outbound messages?
 
 
Outbound messages are messages that you or your business sends to a customer.
Inbound messages are the inquiries and replies that you may receive from a customer.
 
 
What number can I use for texting?
 
 
We assign you a 10-digit textable local number when you first create your account. You will not be texting from your personal phone number.
If you have a business landline phone you would like to turn into a textabl
